title: CAROL: Context-Aware Online Learning for Fuzzer Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2609.06772v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ensemble fuzzing runs multiple fuzzers on a target while a scheduler allocates CPU time among them. Existing schedulers base these decisions on compact summaries of past performance and rules fixed before a campaign. Our measurements reveal two limitations. First, past-reward summaries do not reliably capture performance evolution: after accounting for estimation noise, agreement between consecutive-window rankings is statistically indistinguishable from within-window self-agreement. Second, predictive signals vary across targets: on eight of nine targets, a weighting learned from the other eight predicts reward worse than one learned on the current target. We introduce CAROL, an online scheduler that uses each fuzzer's current context. Already available to the dispatch loop, this context describes reward trends, waiting and plateau time, reached code, and estimation uncertainty. translated_title: CAROL：面向模糊测试调度的上下文感知在线学习
translated_abstract: 集成模糊测试在目标程序上运行多个模糊测试器，并由调度器在它们之间分配CPU时间。现有的调度器基于过去性能的紧凑摘要以及在测试活动开始前就已固定的规则来做出决策。我们的测量揭示了两个局限性。第一，过去奖励的摘要无法可靠地捕捉性能演变：在考虑估计噪声之后，连续窗口排名之间的一致性在统计上与窗口内的自我一致性无法区分。第二，预测信号因目标而异：在九个目标中的八个上，从其他八个目标学习到的权重对奖励的预测效果比在当前目标上学习到的权重更差。我们提出了CAROL，这是一种利用每个模糊测试器当前上下文的在线调度器。该上下文信息已经可供调度循环使用，它描述了奖励趋势、等待和平稳时间、已到达的代码以及估计的不确定性。CAROL以两种方式使用上下文：一种领域引导的方法……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: CAROL是一种上下文感知的在线学习模糊测试调度器，它利用模糊测试器的实时上下文信息（包括奖励趋势、等待与平稳时间、已到达代码及估计不确定性）来动态分配CPU时间，克服了传统基于历史性能摘要和预固定规则调度器的局限性。
en_tdlr: CAROL is a context-aware online learning scheduler for ensemble fuzzing that dynamically allocates CPU time by leveraging each fuzzer's real-time context—including reward trends, waiting and plateau time, reached code, and estimation uncertainty—overcoming the limitations of existing schedulers that rely on past-reward summaries and pre-fixed rules.
